title: The Jakarta Method: Washington's Anticommunist Crusade and the Mass Murder Program that Shaped Our World
summary: Investigative historical monograph documenting the US government's covert financial, logistical, and intelligence assistance to the Indonesian military during the 1965–1966 mass extermination of 500,000 to 1,000,000 suspected communists, trade unionists, and ethnic Chinese, and how this state-terror playbook was subsequently exported across Latin America.
